name: eo-n/ui
summary: Accessible UI primitives built with shadcn styles and Base UI, installed through the shadcn CLI.
description: A component library of accessible, customizable UI primitives for React: shadcn handles the styling with Tailwind v4 and Base UI supplies the behavior primitives. It covers roughly 40 components, from Accordion, Dialog and Combobox to Menubar, Navigation Menu, Emoji Picker, Number Input, Toast and Tooltip. Installation configures the shadcn registry, then installs any component with the shadcn CLI; the docs include dark mode and per-component reference pages.
